column1: Built from the Upper/Lower (4-Day) program that ships in Badger 1.1.15. The sets, reps and rules are the app's, and weights are worked out the way the app works them out.
Run this program in Badger: https://badger.fit/programs/
4 days/week strength + hypertrophy split. Upper A → Lower A → rest → Upper B → Lower B → rest × 2.
Write the weight you used for each exercise in the week columns. Use the same unit all the way down.
